# Fabric Specification Sheet

Spec No.: FS-2041-B

Customer: Northwind Apparel (ref. PO 77-1043)

Date: 2026-03-14

## Construction

Fabric structure: single jersey, 1x1 lycra plated.
The fabric is knitted on a 30" dia. machine at 28 gauge; the stitch length is approx. 2.85 mm. Lycra is fed on every feeder (i.e. full plating), not alternate feeders.

| Parameter | Proposed | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| Machine dia. | 30" | 30" |
| Gauge | 28G | 28G |
| Stitch length | 2.85 mm | 2.9 mm |
| Lycra % | 5 | 4.8 |

## Composition

- 95% cotton (combed, 40s Ne)
- 5% elastane [Lycra 20D]
- Yarn supplier: e.g. Vardhman or equivalent

## Finishing route

1. Heat-setting at 190 °C, speed 18 m/min.
2. Washing (soft flow), pH 5.5-6.0.
3. Drying, then compacting to finished width.

Remarks: Req. finished GSM 180 ± 5; finished width 68".
